segs.p: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṁ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segs.e: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.

segs.p: Atha kho vacchagotto paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṁ sammodi.
segs.e: Then the wanderer Vacchagotta went up to the Buddha and exchanged greetings with him.

segs.p: Sammodanīyaṁ kathaṁ sāraṇīyaṁ vītisāretvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
segs.e: When the greetings and polite conversation were over, he sat down to one side and said to the Buddha:

segs.p: “ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo, yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti—
segs.e: “What is the cause, worthy Gotama, what is the reason why these various misconceptions arise in the world? That is:

segs.p: sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā, antavā lokoti vā, anantavā lokoti vā, taṁ jīvaṁ taṁ sarīranti vā, aññaṁ jīvaṁ aññaṁ sarīranti vā, hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vā, na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vā, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vā, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vā”ti?
segs.e: the cosmos is eternal, or not eternal, or finite, or infinite; the soul and the body are one and the same, or the soul is one thing, the body another; after death, a realized one still exists, or no longer exists, or both still exists and no longer exists, or neither still exists nor no longer exists.”

segs.p: “Rūpe kho, vaccha, aññāṇā, rūpasamudaye aññāṇā, rūpanirodhe aññāṇā, rūpanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇā;
segs.e: “Vaccha, it is because of not knowing form, its origin, its cessation, and the practice that leads to its cessation
that these various misconceptions arise in the world.

segs.p: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vāti.
Ayaṁ kho, vaccha, hetu, ayaṁ paccayo, yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti—
segs.e: This is the cause, this is the reason.”

segs.p: sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā …pe…
neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vā”ti.
Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
segs.e: Then the wanderer Vacchagotta said to the Buddha:

segs.p: “ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo, yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti—
segs.e: “What is the cause, worthy Gotama, what is the reason why these various misconceptions arise in the world? That is:

segs.p: sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā …pe…
segs.e: the cosmos is eternal, or not eternal …

segs.p: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vā”ti?
segs.e: after death, a realized one neither still exists nor no longer exists.”

segs.p: “Vedanāya kho, vaccha, aññāṇā, vedanāsamudaye aññāṇā, vedanānirodhe aññāṇā, vedanānirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇā;
segs.e: “Vaccha, it is because of not knowing feeling, its origin, its cessation, and the practice that leads to its cessation
that these various misconceptions arise in the world.

segs.p: sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā …pe…
neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vāti.
Ayaṁ kho, vaccha, hetu, ayaṁ paccayo, yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti—
segs.e: This is the cause, this is the reason.”

segs.p: sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā …pe…
neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vā”ti.
Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
segs.e: Then the wanderer Vacchagotta said to the Buddha:

segs.p: “ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo, yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti—
segs.e: “What is the cause, worthy Gotama, what is the reason why these various misconceptions arise in the world? …”

segs.p: sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā …pe…
neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vā”ti?
“Saññāya kho, vaccha, aññāṇā, saññāsamudaye aññāṇā, saññānirodhe aññāṇā, saññānirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇā;
segs.e: “Vaccha, it is because of not knowing perception, its origin, its cessation, and the practice that leads to its cessation …”

segs.p: sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā …pe…
neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vāti.
Ayaṁ kho, vaccha, hetu, ayaṁ paccayo, yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti—
sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā …pe…
neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vā”ti.
Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
segs.e: Then the wanderer Vacchagotta said to the Buddha:

segs.p: “ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo, yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti—
segs.e: “What is the cause, worthy Gotama, what is the reason why these various misconceptions arise in the world? …”

segs.p: sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā …pe…
neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vā”ti?
“Saṅkhāresu kho, vaccha, aññāṇā, saṅkhārasamudaye aññāṇā, saṅkhāranirodhe aññāṇā, saṅkhāranirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇā;
segs.e: “Vaccha, it is because of not knowing choices, their origin, their cessation, and the practice that leads to their cessation …”

segs.p: sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā …pe…
neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vāti.
Ayaṁ kho, vaccha, hetu, ayaṁ paccayo, yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti—
sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā …pe…
neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vā”ti.
Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
segs.e: Then the wanderer Vacchagotta said to the Buddha:

segs.p: “ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo, yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti—
segs.e: “What is the cause, worthy Gotama, what is the reason why these various misconceptions arise in the world? …”

segs.p: sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā …pe…
neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vā”ti?
“Viññāṇe kho, vaccha, aññāṇā, viññāṇasamudaye aññāṇā, viññāṇanirodhe aññāṇā, viññāṇanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇā;
segs.e: “Vaccha, it is because of not knowing consciousness, its origin, its cessation, and the practice that leads to its cessation …”

segs.p: sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā …pe…
neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vāti.
Ayaṁ kho, vaccha, hetu, ayaṁ paccayo, yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti—
sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā …pe…
neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vā”ti.

segs.e: Five Discourses on Not Seeing Form, Etc.

segs.p: Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
segs.e: Then the wanderer Vacchagotta said to the Buddha:

segs.p: “ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo, yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti—
segs.e: “What is the cause, worthy Gotama, what is the reason why these various misconceptions arise in the world? …”

segs.p: sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā …pe…
neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vā”ti?

segs.e: “Vaccha, it is because of not seeing form …”

segs.p: viññāṇe kho, vaccha, adassanā …pe… viññāṇanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya adassanā …pe….
segs.e: “… consciousness, its origin, its cessation, and the practice that leads to its cessation …”
Five Discourses on Not Comprehending Form, Etc.

segs.p: “Rūpe kho, vaccha, anabhisamayā …pe… rūpanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya anabhisamayā …pe….
segs.e: “Vaccha, it is because of not comprehending form …
Five Discourses on Not Understanding Form, Etc.

segs.p: Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṁ etadavoca—
ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo …pe…
rūpe kho, vaccha, ananubodhā …pe… “rūpanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ananubodhā …pe….
segs.e: “Vaccha, it is because of not understanding form …
Five Discourses on Not Penetrating Form, Etc.

segs.p: Sāvatthinidānaṁ. Ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo …pe….
“Rūpe kho, vaccha, appaṭivedhā …pe… viññāṇe kho, vaccha, appaṭivedhā …pe….
segs.e: “Vaccha, it is because of not penetrating form …”
Five Discourses on Not Distinguishing Form, Etc.

segs.p: “Rūpe kho, vaccha, asallakkhaṇā …pe… viññāṇe kho, vaccha, asallakkhaṇā …pe….
segs.e: “Vaccha, it is because of not distinguishing form …”
Five Discourses on Not Detecting Form, Etc.

segs.p: “Rūpe kho, vaccha, anupalakkhaṇā …pe… viññāṇe kho, vaccha, anupalakkhaṇā …pe….
segs.e: “Vaccha, it is because of not detecting form …”
Five Discourses on Not Differentiating Form, Etc.

segs.p: “Rūpe kho, vaccha, appaccupalakkhaṇā …pe… viññāṇe kho, vaccha, appaccupalakkhaṇā …pe….
segs.e: “Vaccha, it is because of not differentiating form …”
Five Discourses on Not Examining Form, Etc.

segs.p: “Rūpe kho, vaccha, asamapekkhaṇā …pe… viññāṇe kho, vaccha, asamapekkhaṇā …pe….
segs.e: “Vaccha, it is because of not examining form …”
Five Discourses on Not Scrutinizing Form, Etc.

segs.p: “Rūpe kho, vaccha, appaccupekkhaṇā …pe… viññāṇe kho, vaccha, appaccupekkhaṇā …pe….
segs.e: “Vaccha, it is because of not scrutinizing form …”
Four Discourses on Not Directly Experiencing Form, Etc.

segs.p: Atha kho vacchagotto paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṁ sammodi.
segs.e: Then the wanderer Vacchagotta went up to the Buddha and exchanged greetings with him.

segs.p: Sammodanīyaṁ kathaṁ sāraṇīyaṁ vītisāretvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
segs.e: When the greetings and polite conversation were over, he sat down to one side, and said to the Buddha:

segs.p: “ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo, yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti—
segs.e: “What is the cause, worthy Gotama, what is the reason why these various misconceptions arise in the world? …”

segs.p: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vā”ti?
“Rūpe kho, vaccha, appaccakkhakammā, rūpasamudaye appaccakkhakammā, rūpanirodhe appaccakkhakammā, rūpanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya appaccakkhakammā …pe….
segs.e: “Vaccha, it is because of not directly experiencing form …

segs.p: “Vedanāya kho, vaccha, appaccakkhakammā …pe… vedanānirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya appaccakkhakammā …pe….
“Saññāya kho, vaccha, appaccakkhakammā …pe… saññānirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya appaccakkhakammā …pe….
“Saṅkhāresu kho, vaccha, appaccakkhakammā …pe… saṅkhāranirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya appaccakkhakammā …pe….
“Viññāṇe kho, vaccha, appaccakkhakammā, viññāṇasamudaye appaccakkhakammā, viññāṇanirodhe appaccakkhakammā, viññāṇanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya appaccakkhakammā;
segs.e: “Vaccha, it is because of not directly experiencing consciousness, its origin, its cessation, and the practice that leads to its cessation
that these various misconceptions arise in the world.

segs.p: sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā …pe…
neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vāti.
Ayaṁ kho, vaccha, hetu, ayaṁ paccayo, yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti—
segs.e: This is the cause, this is the reason.”

segs.p: sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā, antavā lokoti vā, anantavā lokoti vā, taṁ jīvaṁ taṁ sarīranti vā, aññaṁ jīvaṁ aññaṁ sarīranti vā, hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vā, na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vā, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vā, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vā”ti.

segs.e: The Linked Discourses with Vacchagotta are complete.
